verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an EU-specific endpoint (api.eu.deepgram.com) for customers requiring EU data processing, and a per-request opt-out for model improvement data retention, showing some regional/data-handling control. However, this is limited to EU vs. default (US) with no evidence of broader region selection (e.g., APAC, other jurisdictions) or a general residency configuration option across the platform. Missing for 10: documented list of all available regions, self-serve region selection in dashboard/API config, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees beyond docs.
